options.name: plugin_bin
options.description: Specify logstash-plugin to use for plugin management.

options.name: proxy_host
options.description: Proxy host to use during plugin installation. Can be specified as a hostname (for example, V(myproxy.example.com)) or as a URL (for example, V(http://myproxy.example.com)). When specified without a scheme, V(http://) is assumed. Sets the O(proxy_host):O(proxy_port) combination as the E(http_proxy) and E(https_proxy) environment variables when running the C(logstash-plugin) command.

options.name: proxy_port
options.description: Proxy port to use during plugin installation.

options.name: version
options.description: Specify version of the plugin to install. If the plugin exists with a previous version, it is B(not) updated.
